name: GL_PERIODS_
description: GL_PERIODS contains information about the accounting periods that are defined using the Accounting Calendar form. Each row includes the start date and end date of the period, period type, fiscal year, period number, and other information. There is a one to many relationship between a row in the GL_PERIOD_SETS table and rows in this table.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: System generated accounting period name.

columns.name: PERIOD_SET_NAME
columns.description: Name of the accounting calendar.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date when the accounting period begins.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date when the accounting period ends.

columns.name: YEAR_START_DATE
columns.description: Date when the year containing this accounting period starts.

columns.name: QUARTER_START_DATE
columns.description: Date when the quarter containing this accounting period starts.

columns.name: PERIOD_TYPE
columns.description: Accounting period type. Examples are Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly.

columns.name: PERIOD_YEAR
columns.description: Denotes the accounting calendar year represented by a numerical value, such as 2009.

columns.name: PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Unique period number within accounting calendar year.

columns.name: QUARTER_NUM
columns.description: Quarter number of accounting period.

columns.name: ENTERED_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: User entered accounting period name.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_PERIOD_FLAG
columns.description: Calendar period adjustment status.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: User defined description of the period.
